description: How a tiny pot start-up became a $43B meme story — and what happened to the rest of the industry. Market-cap race (2007–2026): Tilray's meteoric 2021 spike vs. the crash of Canopy & Aurora, with Constellation Brands watching from the sidelines (and writing big write‑downs). Real market-cap history, real winners and losers.
youtube_description:
The Cannabis Bubble — full story, visuals, and what the market numbers actually say. This chart-race tracks market caps (in USD billions) over two decades: the rapid legalisation era that lifted Canopy and Aurora, Constellation Brands’ big strategic bet (and later write-downs), and Tilray’s extraordinary 2021 meme-fueled spike to roughly $43B — followed by a brutal crash.

In this video we show: the legalization optimism (2016–2019), the 2018–2019 valuations, how big beverage & alcohol incumbents (Constellation) positioned themselves, the 2020–2021 retail/speculative surge that made Tilray a headline act, and the consolidation/cleanup that followed (2022–2026). All figures are market-cap approximations based on public market data and company reports (key peaks & collapse points are documented in financial press and filings).

Love deep dives like this? Smash Subscribe, hit the bell, and drop a comment with which company surprised you most. Want the raw CSV for your own edits? Link in the pinned comment. 

Sources: company filings, exchange market data, and major financial press coverage (Tilray peak Feb 2021, Canopy valuation peaks 2018, Constellation investment & later write-downs).
